meta.title_default: Inkbin — Anonymous and Secure Editorial Publishing
meta.description: Open-source editorial platform for anonymous and secure code and text sharing with short, non-sequential URLs.

nav.no_history: No recent pastes in this browser.
nav.clear_history_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear all local history?

editor.heading: New publication
editor.title_placeholder: e.g.: docker-compose.yml or Production logs analysis
editor.toolbar_hint: Paste your code or type directly (Tab supported)
editor.content_placeholder: Paste the content to share here...
editor.format_base64_hint: Base64 is an encoding format, not encryption — anyone with the link can decode it.
editor.burn_hint: The paste will be permanently purged after the first confirmed view.
editor.alert_empty: Please enter paste content before publishing.
editor.alert_error: An error occurred while publishing the paste.
editor.desc_encrypt: Encrypt in browser: content is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before upload. The key is added to the share link after “#” and never sent to the server — lose the full link and the paste can't be decrypted.
editor.desc_burn: Burn after read: the paste is deleted after the first confirmed view — readers are asked to confirm before it opens.
editor.desc_base64: Base64: Base64 is encoding, not encryption — anyone with the link can decode it.
editor.desc_password: Password: the paste requires a password to view, verified securely with Argon2id.

modal.title: Paste created successfully!
modal.qr_code_hint: Scan with your phone's camera to open on mobile
modal.qr_code_aria: QR Code for mobile access to the published paste
modal.warning: Attention: As publication is anonymous, save this key! It is required if you decide to delete the paste before expiration. It will not be shown again.
modal.encrypted_notice: Encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The decryption key resides exclusively after the '#' in the URL and was never sent to the server. If you lose this complete link, the content cannot be recovered.

burn.title: This paste will be destroyed after reading
burn.description: The author configured this document to be permanently purged from the server as soon as it is opened. Would you like to reveal the content now?
burn.burned_banner: This document has been permanently purged from the database during this view.

viewer.delete_aria: Delete this paste with your Admin Delete Token
viewer.base64_notice: Notice: This content is Base64 encoded. Base64 is an encoding, not encryption — anyone with the link can read it.
viewer.encrypted_missing_key: Decryption key missing from link (#key). Without the original key fragment, this document cannot be decrypted.
viewer.encrypted_error: Decryption failed. The key in the link is invalid or corrupted.

delete.description: Definitive deletion physically removes this paste from the database and invalidates the cache. This operation is immediate and irreversible.
delete.token_placeholder: Paste the token received upon creation here
delete.token_hint: Exclusive 64-character token generated when the paste was created.

password.description: This document has been protected by its creator. Enter the credentials below to decrypt and view the full content.
password.label: Access password
password.placeholder: Enter the password for this paste
password.network_error: Error connecting to server. Try again.

error404.heading: 404 · Record unavailable
error404.title: Paste not found
error404.message: The text you are looking for may have expired according to the configured policy, was deleted by the author, or never existed.

error451.page_title: Content Unavailable for Legal Reasons — Inkbin
error451.heading: 451 · Unavailable for legal reasons
error451.title: Paste deactivated by moderation
error451.message: This document was administratively deactivated due to a report or detected violation of platform terms of service (e.g. malicious code, leak of private credentials, or abusive content).

clipboard.copy_failed: Could not copy. Please select text and copy manually.

features.heading: Platform Guarantees & Features
features.anonymous_desc: No account, no raw IPs stored
features.expiry_desc: Configurable retention from 10 minutes to 1 week
features.developer_desc: HTTP API, curl and raw text links
features.no_signup_desc: Open and simple, you stay in total control
features.delete_token_desc: One-time delete code for instant removal
